messages:
Emma: Kicking off vendor onboarding for Canada (montreal / canada-central). Partner: NimbusCloud. Need marketplace SKU entitlement + regional GPU quota. Target soft-launch in 2 weeks.
Victor: which SKU? GPUs + memory?
Emma: Nimbus proposed `nimbus.a100-80` (80GB A100 class). Initial capacity 6 units across zones, proposal reserved 4 + burst 2.
Hana: Marketplace vs Dedicated plan?
Emma: Both. Marketplace self-serve SKU and a Dedicated commit offer for enterprise customers.
Priya (NimbusCloud): We can support images, NFS access, and optional NVLink; we'll provide guide and test image.
LegalBot: Need signed partner addendum + DPA. Estimate 3-5 business days once partner returns docs.
Victor: Cloud quota required before we can list SKU. I opened ticket Q-6020 and linked to MP-6002 (marketplace ticket). Cloud eng needs Marketplace ticket ID + signed partner contract.
MarketplaceBot: Created MP-6002 for NimbusCloud:nimbus.a100-80. Status: in review. ETA 4 business days.
Emma: Ops ask: network cidr and peering plan. Can Nimbus provide preferred peer CIDR?
Priya (NimbusCloud): We'll use `172.31.40.0/28` per AZ. Can you confirm expected peer ranges on your side?
OpsOncall: Template below. If we get confirmed CIDRs by tomorrow EOD we can schedule peering Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC.
OpsOncall: ```peering-request: project=redwood-ca-central; requested_peer=172.31.40.0/28; purpose=marketplace-nimbus onboarding```
OpsOncall: Firewall snippet: `allow tcp 22,1024-65535 from nimbus_peer to redwood-gpu-nodes`
Victor: Billing question: expose unit as `instance-hour` or `gpu-hour`? Pricing metric?
Billing: Expose as `gpu-hour` but SKU name should be instance-based: `redwood.instance.gpu.nimbus_a100_80`. We'll annotate billing metric `gpu-hours`.
Hana: Marketing wants 5 business days lead time for public announcement; can do invite-only early access 48hrs after provisioning.
Emma: Action items: 1) Priya to return signed addendum + DPA (Priya: timeline?). 2) Marketplace MP-6002 in flight. 3) Victor to follow cloud quota Q-6020 with cloud-eng. 4) OpsOncall to provision peering once CIDRs confirmed. 5) Billing to set SKU metric and pricing.
Priya (NimbusCloud): We can sign addendum by next Tue EOD. Also will send test AMI and SSH key instructions.
Victor: Cloud-eng owner (Maya) asked for partner contract + MP id before quota bump. I'll DM Maya.
LegalBot: I'll queue the addendum review as high priority once received.
MarketplaceBot: MP-6002 status -> In review by marketplace ops.
Emma: Any blockers?
Billing: blocker: pricing tier confirmation and marketplace price floor. Need final price by Fri.
Hana: blocker: signed addendum timing — if delayed, we push soft-launch.
Priya (NimbusCloud): We'll prioritize the signatures and upload SOC2 summary to the secure folder.
Emma: Thanks all. I'll post a provisioning checklist in this thread when peering window confirmed. :thumbsup:
